talk.jaymoskingdoms.sky_usurper.claim.1: This hall wants a stronger hand than yours. I've come to take it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sky_usurper.claim.2: I didn't climb all this way to bow. Step down, or be put down.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sky_usurper.claim.3: A castle in the clouds, and a soft lord in it. That ends today.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sky_usurper.answer.1: Wardens! Throw this upstart off my wall!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sky_usurper.answer.2: You'll find the fall from here is a long one.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sky_usurper.answer.3: Another one who thinks a seat is taken with a sword. To me, wardens!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sky_usurper.taken.1: The seat is mine. Kneel, all of you, and keep your places.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.sky_usurper.taken.2: The old lord is done. This castle answers to me now.
